exclusion_reason: The trace-corpus admission gate is implemented as one canonical serialization plus a per-trace verifier that rejects incomplete provenance, an unproven or leaking redaction, and a non-byte-stable canonical form, exercised against synthetic traces. The benchmark stays red because the real captured traces come from the absent Win32 runtime (BPTK-010), so the corpus carries no real oracle trace to freeze.
promotion_trigger: Promote when every corpus trace carries provenance and redaction proof and regenerates byte-stably.
expected_failing_assertion: No captured trace exists in the corpus.
active_gate_evidence: The trace-corpus suite covers the admitted well-formed trace, the incomplete-provenance rejection, the leaked personal-data rejection, the mismatched-proof rejection, and the order-independent byte-stability of the canonical form.
procedure: Capture each declared trace through the recording pipeline.
Verify provenance and redaction proof per trace.
pass_criterion: Provenance and redaction proof exist per trace.
